subject.title: test(qa): add direct provider and scheduler runtime evidence

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as a three-lane QA evidence task, or narrow it to only the missing Telegram startup and heartbeat script-evidence executables?
rationale: The maintainer label and MEMBER author block cleanup automation, and source inspection shows current main already covers part of the requested evidence shape while leaving a meaningful scope choice for maintainers.

options.title: Keep and narrow the remaining scope
options.body: Track the issue until Telegram startup blocked/pass evidence and heartbeat shared script evidence are added, while treating the existing OTEL producer as already covered unless maintainers want changes there.

options.title: Keep the full three-lane task
options.body: Require a follow-up PR to refresh OTEL, heartbeat, and Telegram together so all three lanes share one evidence shape and artifact convention.

options.title: Close only after maintainer confirmation
options.body: Close this only if maintainers explicitly decide the existing OTEL producer, heartbeat e2e test, and Telegram live adapter already satisfy the intended release proof.

recommendation.title: Keep and narrow the remaining scope
recommendation.body: Track the issue until Telegram startup blocked/pass evidence and heartbeat shared script evidence are added, while treating the existing OTEL producer as already covered unless maintainers want changes there.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored this issue and the recent merged Telegram live adapter work that owns the most clearly missing acceptance criterion.
